Documentary Celebrates Late Rush Drummer Neil Peart's Legacy

A new documentary is set to celebrate the legacy of Neil Peart, the late drummer for the Canadian rock band Rush. The film will feature insights from bandmates Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson, who share their favorite memories of Peart. The documentary focuses on highlighting Peart's contributions and life.
